searchText: We probably need parallel fork-independent track of work with some common checkpoints; with ssz / discv5 / blob pool sharding / p2p tests readiness / etc there it's a nice idea btw, we finished implementing eth/70 - EIP-7975 (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7975) it would be nice to have a call about that we need this EIP to scale beyond 80M gas so it is somewhat urgent to get it launched in clients I will also remove eth/68 in Geth very soon I haven't seen too much progress on v5 in Besu lately, so I need to double check with the team if these dates are reasonable for us, but since I also agree that deprecating it along with the Glamsterdam fork, then theoretically that gives use more time, and should not block any other client that wants to enable it first The work is fork-independent, but forks can be used to make sure that all nodes/clients are running with discv5 enabled, to then safely turn off / remove discv4.
